query: Examples and documentation for implementing custom AscendC kernels with kernel_operator.h (TPipe/TQue), tiling data, host op registration (register/op_def_registry.h), and PyTorch NPU binding (EXEC_NPU_CMD), including GEMM/MatMul, max reduction, subtract-mean, and GELU.
Ascend C high-level APIs for MatMul/GEMM, ReduceMax/ReduceMean, elementwise subtraction, and GELU, including tiling data structures and end-to-end custom operator examples for PyTorch integration.
Ascend C MatMul, ReduceMax/ReduceMean, and GELU high-level API usage with tiling examples for custom kernels
